biocs.name: Globally Uncommon IP Address by Common Process
biocs.description: Detection of a common Windows process (e.g., powershell.exe) connecting to a globally uncommon IP address.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in (select ip from uncommon_ips)
| filter not action_remote_ip in (select ip from known_good_ips)

abiocs.name: Unusual Network Behavior from Common Process
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a common Windows process initiates a connection to an IP address not previously seen in the environment.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip not in (select distinct action_remote_ip from xdr_data where event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and timestamp > now() - 30d)
| filter action_remote_ip in (select ip from uncommon_ips)

xql_queries.name: Hunt for PowerShell connecting to uncommon IPs
